title: Controlled Government PFM Journey
principle: Signals inform strategy; strategy constrains the fiscal envelope; the approved budget authorizes execution; cash and accounting follow controlled authority; consolidation and final statements close the cycle and feed the next planning round.

stages.name: Signals & Government Direction
stages.authority: Analyst validates the signal; management confirms whether it becomes a planning assumption.
logic: Separate observed fact from AI interpretation.
Score confidence, materiality, time horizon and affected fiscal domains.
Map each signal to revenue, expenditure, cash, debt, asset/liability or service-demand exposure.
Promote only validated signals into the fiscal-planning assumption register.
calculations: Materiality score = configured impact × likelihood × horizon weighting
Confidence = source quality + recency + corroboration
Exposure map = signal → fiscal driver → affected mandate/entity/category
controls: Low-confidence signals cannot become approved assumptions automatically

stages.name: Fiscal Strategy & Priorities
stages.authority: Leadership approves strategic fiscal direction and priority choices.
logic: Build baseline, upside and downside fiscal scenarios.
Translate strategic priorities into fiscal implications.
Identify expenditure pressures, revenue risks, contingent liabilities and headroom.
Prepare options; do not make the strategic decision.
calculations: Baseline fiscal balance = projected revenue − projected expenditure
Scenario variance = scenario result − baseline result
Fiscal-risk exposure = probability-weighted financial exposure where an approved method exists

stages.name: Macro-Fiscal Framework & Fiscal Envelope
stages.authority: Authorized fiscal authority approves aggregate resource and expenditure envelope.
logic: Establish the maximum affordable aggregate envelope before entity allocation.
Separate baseline obligations, committed initiatives and new-policy space.
Retain configured reserves/buffers before distributing ceilings.
Create a medium-term frame where data exists; do not exceed approved aggregate authority.
calculations: Indicative fiscal space = projected resources + approved financing − baseline obligations − reserves/buffers
Aggregate expenditure ceiling = approved affordable expenditure envelope
Headroom = approved ceiling − baseline committed expenditure
controls: No entity allocations before envelope approval

stages.name: Budget Allocation & Formulation
stages.authority: Budget authority validates ceilings and submits the draft budget for formal approval.
logic: Allocate within the approved aggregate ceiling.
Challenge entity requests against priorities, prior execution, cost/workload drivers and deliverability.
Keep baseline, mandatory commitments, new initiatives and capital separately visible.
Generate multiple allocation options when trade-offs remain.
calculations: Entity headroom = proposed ceiling − validated baseline
Funding gap = validated requirement − proposed ceiling
Allocation variance = proposed allocation − prior approved allocation
Portfolio affordability: Σ entity allocations + reserves ≤ aggregate ceiling

stages.name: Budget Approval & Appropriation
stages.authority: Formal budget/appropriation authority remains entirely human/statutory.
logic: Validate that the final draft reconciles to the approved envelope and classifications.
Prepare the approval brief and changes between versions.
Once formally approved, freeze the original-budget baseline and retain all subsequent amendments separately.
calculations: Original budget = formally approved appropriation baseline
Control reconciliation: Σ approved entity appropriations = approved aggregate appropriation, subject to authorized reserves/classification
controls: Only authorized approver can establish appropriation
Original budget never overwritten by later amendments

stages.name: Allotment, Cash Plan & Funding Schedule
stages.authority: Authorized budget/treasury officers approve allotments and funding releases.
logic: Translate annual authority into controlled execution and monthly cash plans.
Separate budget authority from cash availability: an approved budget does not automatically mean immediate cash release.
Align entity need with execution milestones and treasury liquidity.
calculations: Monthly funding need = forecast eligible payments due − available entity cash/approved offsets
Funding variance = requested amount − modelled need
Closing liquidity = opening cash + collections + financing − payments − investments
controls: Funding request above need routed to exception

stages.name: Budget Execution, Commitments & Payments
stages.authority: Transactions follow delegated authority, commitment and payment controls.
logic: Check budget authority before commitments and eligible payments.
Track each transaction through commitment → obligation → payment → accounting status.
Forecast year-end outturn from actuals, outstanding commitments and expected delivery.
Route breaches and exceptions instead of bypassing controls.
calculations: Adjusted budget = original budget + approved amendments
Available balance = adjusted budget − controlled commitments/obligations/actuals according to approved control basis
Forecast variance = forecast outturn − adjusted budget
Utilization = selected controlled expenditure measure ÷ adjusted budget
controls: Data lineage from transaction to budget line
stages.autonomy: Monitor, validate and prepare eligible actions

stages.name: Monitoring, Forecasting & In-Year Budget Amendment
stages.authority: Only authorized officers approve virements, supplements, reductions or reallocations.
logic: Detect material forecast variance early.
Distinguish timing variance from permanent saving/pressure.
Assess amendment against authority, funding source, priority and downstream cash/accounting impact.
Once approved, update adjusted budget while preserving the original appropriation baseline.
calculations: Forecast variance = forecast outturn − adjusted budget
Proposed adjusted budget = current adjusted budget + proposed authorized amendment
Post-amendment headroom = proposed adjusted budget − forecast outturn

stages.name: Treasury, Revenue & Financial Operations
stages.agent: Treasury / Revenue / Finance Operations Agent Group
stages.owner: Treasury, Revenue and Finance Operations Authorities
stages.authority: Fund releases, refunds, bank/investment actions, pricing/legal determinations and material transfers require authorized approval.
logic: Reconcile collections to receivables and banks.
Validate refund entitlement and evidence before preparing a case.
Compare entity monthly funding request with approved budget, commitments and modelled need.
Reconcile inter-entity and intergovernmental transactions symmetrically.
Manage liquidity and surplus-maturity options within approved counterparty/risk limits.
Keep legal/pricing recommendations separate from formal legal or pricing authority.
calculations: Revenue variance = actual collections − period revenue plan
Reconciliation difference = source-system amount − bank/ledger matched amount
Funding gap = requested amount − validated modelled need
Inter-entity imbalance = entity A receivable/payable mirror − entity B counterpart
Closing cash = opening cash + collections + financing − payments − investments
stages.autonomy: High automation for matching/reconciliation; protected actions remain gated

stages.name: Accounting, Reconciliation & Period Close
stages.authority: Authorized accounting officers approve journals, close periods and certify balances.
logic: Reconcile budget, cash and accrual views before close.
Identify missing postings, cut-off issues and unsupported balances.
Prepare controlled journals with evidence and approver routing.
Prevent close when material reconciliation or evidence exceptions remain.
calculations: Accrual-cash bridge = accrued expense − cash paid, explained by liabilities/timing/classification
Trial-balance check = total debits − total credits = 0
Open-reconciliation count and material unresolved difference
controls: No AI period close or balance certification
stages.autonomy: Reconcile and prepare; certification remains human

stages.name: Government Consolidation & Eliminations
stages.authority: Authorized consolidation/accounting authority certifies consolidated balances.
logic: Validate every entity package before inclusion.
Match reciprocal inter-entity balances and route differences for resolution.
Eliminate internal transactions/balances according to approved rules.
Consolidate only within the approved reporting perimeter and retain entity-to-group lineage.
calculations: Consolidated balance = Σ certified entity balances − approved eliminations + approved consolidation adjustments
Elimination difference = entity-reported reciprocal amounts before approved adjustment
Unresolved difference ratio = unresolved material differences ÷ consolidated relevant balance
stages.autonomy: Match, eliminate by approved rules, prepare draft

stages.name: Final Financial Statements & Fiscal Health
stages.authority: Formal approval, certification, audit/assurance and publication remain statutory/human responsibilities.
logic: Generate the full draft reporting package from certified consolidated balances.
Check consistency across statements, notes, budget comparison and cash flow.
Separate draft AI-prepared narrative from certified financial statements.
Feed final outturn, risks and structural variances into the next Signals/Strategy cycle.
calculations: Budget variance = final actual − final adjusted budget
Cash/accrual difference = recognized accrual position − related cash movement, with explanation
Fiscal-health view = budget + cash + accrual + revenue + risk + data-integrity dimensions; methodology must be approved before use as an official KPI
controls: Feedback loop does not rewrite approved historical records
stages.autonomy: Prepare draft, explain variances, support assurance
